No downgrade to REJECTED, BLOCKED or MEASUREMENT_INVALID as a claim status is warranted: nothing about the claim was falsified, the instrument transaction itself completed validly, and the failure is a task-bank satisfiability defect, not an invalid measurement of the claim's own quantities. reason: The frozen pre-freeze gate decided this packet before any outcome was read. spec.json.dynamic_range_certified=false with an all-null dynamic_range_certificate was hashed into freeze.json, and frozen prereg.md sections 5/12 and its closing line state that if dynamic_range_certified != true at freeze time the experiment is MEASUREMENT_INVALID and must not proceed to EXECUTE. The producer correctly applied that contract (result.json.status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE) and the independent audit PASSED with producer_claim_supported=false and required_fixes naming the task-bank redesign, the shipped-carrier regression, the retrieval_calls-excluded cost metric and the support-regex collapse (audit.json). The Director adopts MEASUREMENT_INVALID and the audit's claim_ceiling: no claim about C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY can be made. The diagnostic re-run confirms the certificate failure first recorded in parent EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064: cold and retrieval success_rate=1.0 at novelty 0.5 and 0.75 on this deterministic one-request GET substrate and cost_per_success is saturated at 2.0 composite units for every arm with defined successes, so there is no cost/novelty headroom to compare; C1 failed and C2-C5 were not evaluable (derived/decision_rule_eval.json), so the primary premise is untested, not falsified. The treatment's 0.45 success_rate is entirely explained by the induced support regex ^<type>\-00[0-9]{1}$ accepting only identifiers 001-009 (raw_evidence/induced_mechanisms.json) — a support-boundary observation, not a measured economic disadvantage. The diagnostic ran a vendored copy of audited kernel blob b15ed848 because shipped HEAD src/spider/kernel.py was regressed to blob cfec9866 by merge 5601ede3 (missing distill_parameterized/TrajectoryCounters/_support_accepts/rebind; raw_evidence/shipped_kernel_probe.json), so the shipped carrier is not certified by this run. Per frozen prereg section 9, MEASUREMENT_INVALID carries no claim update: C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY is retained at the accepted Codex running status EXPERIMENTAL (the registry HYPOTHESIS field is stale and is not overridden), no promotion is possible (promote_to_product=false; no frozen gate passed, the audit supports no claim ceiling, and no product code survived an audit), and continue=false because the successor requires a redesigned task bank with a satisfiable pre-freeze certificate, a bound/restored audited treatment carrier, an honest retrieval_calls-inclusive cost metric, and a NEW Global Research Director mandate — the Product lane must not self-dispatch. A bounded program-level measurement-validity instance is transmitted to C-MEAS-VALID: the design's own mandatory pre-freeze certificate gate was frozen in an unsatisfied state, a preregistration-control defect rather than an infrastructure failure, and the second consecutive zero-dynamic-range failure on this substrate.
